# Load auto-generated module list from project.json
# Generated by tools/generate_ui.py → generated/modules.cmake
set(PRODUCT_MODULES "")
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/modules.cmake")
    include("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/modules.cmake")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.cpp"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/generated"
    PRIV_REQUIRES modesp_core modesp_services modesp_hal modesp_net ${PRODUCT_MODULES}
)

# Cloud backend: compile-time Kconfig choice
if(CONFIG_MODESP_CLOUD_AWS)
    idf_component_get_property(main_lib ${COMPONENT_NAME} COMPONENT_LIB)
    target_link_libraries(${main_lib} PRIVATE idf::modesp_aws)
else()
    idf_component_get_property(main_lib ${COMPONENT_NAME} COMPONENT_LIB)
    target_link_libraries(${main_lib} PRIVATE idf::modesp_mqtt)
endif()
